title: BELLATRIX Agent project settings (.bellatrix/config.json)
description: Where your BELLATRIX test project and your test-case files are. Written by `bellatrix init`, read by the BELLATRIX skills and by `bellatrix config show|validate`. Commit this file.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema (lets editors validate the file).

testCasesDir.description: Folder of the test-case files ({testCasesDir}/{suite}/TC-{id}.md), relative to the repository root. Same as SPECTRA's tests.dir; default test-cases.

domains.description: Settings per BELLATRIX domain. A domain without a project means: ask the user.

relativePath.description: A repository-relative path with forward slashes and no '..' segment.

testCasesDir.description: Overrides the top-level testCasesDir for this domain.

path.description: The project file: a .csproj (C#), pom.xml or build.gradle(.kts) (Java), or package.json (TypeScript).

name.description: The project name (C#: the .csproj name; Java: the artifactId; TypeScript: the package name).

rootNamespace.description: C#: the root namespace. Java: the base package of the test sources. Null when unknown or not used (TypeScript).

buildCommand.description: The command that compiles the tests without running them, from the repository root.
